Class PasskeyLoginMethod

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.passkey.PasskeyLoginMethod
All Implemented Interfaces:
PasswordlessLoginMethod
public class PasskeyLoginMethod extends Object implements PasswordlessLoginMethod
Passkey sign-in and registration with Spring Security's passkey filters, at who's URLs under who.base-path. who adds the filters itself (see PasskeyFilters) rather than calling Spring's webAuthn(), which fixes their URLs, and gives them who's collaborators:
  • who's two repositories and the application's WebAuthnRelyingPartyOperations bean.
  • The sign-in filter gets who's provider, observed and publishing events as Spring's own managers do, WhoSessionSecurityContextRepository, the chain's shared SessionAuthenticationStrategy (so the session id changes and CSRF rotates at sign-in; Spring's default does neither) and who's JSON answers.
  • Spring's default registration page is off.
  • A PasskeyRegistrationGuardFilter supplies the registration answers Spring has no hook for. Listing and removing passkeys is PasskeysController's.
  • The success handler and the guard publish through the application's WhoEventPublisher bean, if it has one: a successful sign-in publishes SignInSucceeded once its session is saved.

The provider and the guard filter are not beans: an AuthenticationProvider bean would join the app's global authentication manager, and a filter bean would be registered as a servlet filter.

      public PasskeyLoginMethod(WhoPaths paths, JdbcWhoPasskeyUserRepository userRepository, JdbcWhoPasskeyCredentialRepository credentialRepository, org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationProvider authenticationProvider, WhoSessionSecurityContextRepository sessionRepository, tools.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper jsonMapper, Clock clock, Duration registrationWindow)
      Creates the login method.
      Parameters:
      paths - where the passkey endpoints live
      userRepository - who's user entities
      credentialRepository - who's credential records
      authenticationProvider - signs in with a verified passkey
      sessionRepository - stores the who session at sign-in
      jsonMapper - writes the sign-in success answer
      clock - the current time, for the registration window
      registrationWindow - how long after signing in a passkey may be registered; also how long after signing in one may be removed
